The [[Ikas-Adno/Legends|Ikas-Adno]] '''Starhawk''' was a model of [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] released long before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]; at which time, it was a revolutionary design. Decades later, it remained the most popular [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] in the galaxy. Among others, it was used by [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] and [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|his pirate gang]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:StarhawkSpeederBike-FF.png|thumb|left|200px|Starhawks were a staple of Hondo Ohnaka's gang]]
It was a well known [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]], because of its sturdy build. The [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] was different from other speeders, because of the possibility to add a sidecar to the bike. The Starhawk was very reliable in combat and could transport goods.<ref name="VGUB">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Visual Guide: Ultimate Battles]]''</ref> The pilot and one passenger usually used handheld [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]] to fight against enemies, although some speeders had twin blasters built into them. Each swoop had [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beams]] in the back, so it could drag cargo behind it.<ref name="TGG" />

==History==
[[File:Ohnakas_biker_gang.png|thumb|right|250px|Turk Falso leading a group of pirates on Starhawks]]
Ohnaka obtained these speeders after he fled from [[Porla/Legends|Porla]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] on [[Boonta/Legends|Boonta]]. He stole Porla's skiff and took with him several of these [[Swoop/Legends|swoops]] and [[WLO-5 speeder tank/Legends|Ubrikkian tanks]].<ref name="VGUB" /> [[Turk Falso/Legends|Turk Falso]], the [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] used these swoops to engage a group of [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] led by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Stone (clone trooper)/Legends|Stone]] and [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]]. The clones crash landed in the [[Doshar fields/Legends|Doshar fields]] of [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]], after they were shot down by a [[Flarestar-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Flarestar''-class attack shuttle]] piloted by [[Barb Mentir/Legends|Barb Mentir]], the accomplice of Falso to bring a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Ransom/Legends|ransom]] to Ohnaka in exchange for the captive [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. The pirates cut the clones off from their crashed [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], took the spice crates out of the shuttle and attached energy couplers to the crates to tow them away with their bikes. Jar Jar and the clones chased the pirates by riding on [[Skalder/Legends|skalders]], creatures native of Florrum. They managed to get the spice back from the pirates and Falso was the only one to escape, returning back to the [[Hondo's complex/Legends|pirate base]].<ref name="TGG" />
